a.xlink:title: Infrastructure:Municipalities: A municipality: the territory of a city or a town, delimited in space and represented by a polygon or a multipolygon.…
Infrastructure:adjacentMunicipalityTo: Links two municipalities that share a border.
Infrastructure:Neighborhood: A geographically delimited urban area that comprises streets, points of interest and other urban infrastructure…
Infrastructure:isPartOfMunicipalities: Links a neighbourhood to the municipality it belongs to.
Infrastructure:adjacentNeighborhoodTo: Links two neighbourhoods that share a border.
Infrastructure:Streets: A street used by vehicles and pedestrians, made of one or more road segments.
Infrastructure:IsPartOfNeighborhood: Links a street to the neighbourhood it belongs to.
Infrastructure:adjacentStreetTo: Links two streets that touch each other.
Infrastructure:Road_segment: A portion of road between two reference points, such as intersections or stops. Its identity is determined by its…
Infrastructure:HasSegments: Links a street to one of its road segments.
Infrastructure:Intersection: A junction where several streets meet, where vehicles and pedestrians follow signage to take the right direction.
Infrastructure:HasIntersection: Links a street to an intersection located on it.
Infrastructure:UrbanEntity: Any entity of the urban and peri-urban environment considered in mobility modelling. It is the top class of the…
Infrastructure:Aggregates: Links an urban entity to a finer-grained entity that it groups, for example a…
Infrastructure:GranularityLevel: The level of spatial granularity of an urban entity: micro (street level), meso (neighbourhood level) or macro…
Infrastructure:hasGranularityLevel: Links an urban entity to its granularity level: Micro, Meso or Macro.
Infrastructure:Sidewalk: A paved pathway adjacent to a street, intended for pedestrian use.
Infrastructure:attached_to: Links a sidewalk to the street along which it runs.
Infrastructure:Obstacles: An object or a structure on the street that may block or slow down vehicles or pedestrians.
Infrastructure:Blocks: Links an obstacle to the road segment that it blocks.
Infrastructure:IsPartOfStreet: Links a road segment to the street it belongs to. It specialises the spatial relation…
Infrastructure:connectedToIntersection: Links a road segment to an intersection at one of its ends.
Infrastructure:Traffic_control: The signs, traffic lights and road markings that regulate traffic and warn or inform drivers and pedestrians.
Infrastructure:EquippedBy: Links a road segment to a traffic control device (a sign or a light) installed on it.
Infrastructure:hasTrafficControl: Links an intersection to a traffic control device (a sign or a light) installed there.
Infrastructure:Sensor: A device that collects traffic data, such as vehicle speed, traffic volume or density on a road.
Infrastructure:hasSensor: Links an intersection to a sensor installed there.
Infrastructure:Building: A building located along a street.
Infrastructure:frontsOnStreet: Links a building to the street it faces.

Infrastructure:locatedInNeighborhood: Links an urban entity, such as a road segment, to the neighbourhood in which it is…
Infrastructure:Road_markings: Road surface markings that guide traffic, such as lane lines, crosswalks and directional arrows.
Infrastructure:LocatedOnStreet: Links a road marking to the road segment on which it is painted.
Infrastructure:vehicle: A motorised or non-motorised means of transport used on roads to move people or goods.
Infrastructure:RunsOnStreet: Links a vehicle to a street on which it runs.
Infrastructure:Parking: A designated area for parking vehicles, such as a car park or parking spaces.
Infrastructure:parked_in: Links a vehicle to the parking area where it is parked.
Infrastructure:RondAbout: A roundabout: a circular intersection where traffic flows around a central island.
Infrastructure:RondAboutEquippedBy: Links a roundabout to a traffic control device installed on it.
Infrastructure:Pedestrians: People walking along streets, crossing roads or using sidewalks.
Infrastructure:WalkOn: Links a pedestrian to the sidewalk on which he or she walks.
